description: The fixed title and prompt of an analysis task (ADR-095 sections 1 and 6), the same in the web client (web/src/core/analysis/) and the agent tool (src/agent_platform/optimize.py). `templates`: per language the title and the prompt with the placeholders {scope}, {since} and {until}; `scopes`: per language the text of the scope `org` and of the scope `wg` (with {name}, the workgroup's name). Times are ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds. Hand-maintained data (no generator); `cases` are the vectors both sides test.

en.title: Optimize processes
en.prompt: Optimize processes: analyse {scope} from {since} to {until} and propose improvements.

de.title: Prozesse optimieren
de.prompt: Prozesse optimieren: Analysiere {scope} von {since} bis {until} und schlage Verbesserungen vor.
